seo.title: What's in the House? 🛏️🛁 Things in the House for Kids | Guessing Game | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Can your little one guess what's in the house from two clues? 🤔 Look at the clues, think, and shout the answer with Kiddo!

A quick things-in-the-house guessing game for kids. Children learn 4 household words:
🛏️ Bed (moon + sleepy face)
🛁 Bathtub (bubbles + soap)
🛋️ Sofa (TV + popcorn)
🪥 Toothbrush (teeth + sparkles)

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more Guess with Kiddo games: animals, vehicles, sports, clothes and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
